name: Dribble-First Deliberate Playmaker
description: A patient, ball-controlling creator who prefers slow, purposeful buildup. Keeps possession under pressure, uses measured dribbles to probe gaps, and mainly creates chances through well-timed movements and indirect signals rather than quick feeds. Looks for high-percentage routes to the goal or a safe through-ball to the teammate when a clear lane appears, maintaining spacing to prevent turnovers while guiding the play toward a patient finishing opportunity.

name: Dribble-First Rapid Attacker
description: A fast, aggressive ball handler who explodes with bursts of dribbling to break through compact defense. Prioritizes quick decision-making after the initial move, choosing to shoot or pivot into a fast, decisive pass as soon as an opening is detected. Keeps tempo high to disrupt the red team’s setup and creates immediate scoring chances, while still staying mindful of ball security and rough spacing to support the teammate in finishing.

name: Pass-First Deliberate Organizer
description: A patient facilitator who prioritizes accurate, well-placed passes over individual dribbles. Builds possession to neutralize pressure, using measured rotations and spacing to invite teammates into dangerous zones. Looks for trusted through-passes or controlled lays-offs when a clear, high-probability opportunity exists, coordinating with the teammate through positioning cues rather than explicit communication to sustain a slow, methodical advance toward goal.

name: Pass-First Rapid Striker
description: A quick, opportunistic playmaker who favors fast, precise combinations with the teammate. Emphasizes rapid tempo and smart distribution to exploit gaps in the red defense, using short exchanges and well-timed off-ball runs to create one-two opportunities or immediate finishing passes. Keeps pressure on the goal with swift decisions, aiming for fast goals while maintaining team coherence through continuous, though non-verbal, spatial signaling.
